notes.title: 版本更新 version update
notes.content:
1、调整技能卡牌的位置，使其完全限制在屏幕当中。
2、新增ESC可直接跳过开场动画功能

1. Adjust the position of the skill card to completely confine it within the screen.
2. Add ESC function to skip the opening animation directly

notes.title: 反馈修复 Feedback repair
notes.content:
1、初始射速由原来的1S/1调整为0.5S/1
2、修复导弹发射无的音效问题
3、修复设置面板滑鼠无效问题

1. The initial firing rate has been adjusted from 1S/1 to 0.5S/1
2. Fix the sound effect issue of missile launch without sound effects
3. Fix the issue of invalid mouse settings in the settings panel
